$comment: Farrow & Ball runs Magento 2 with a custom theme and one store per country; this config targets the US store, whose product URLs are /us/<type>/<slug> or /us/paint/<colour>/<finish> (from media/sitemap/sitemap_us_store_product.xml; the UK store at the root path is GBP and does not match). Prices are in US dollars and returned in cents. Wallpaper and accessory pages carry the price in the Magento price box (finalPrice, oldPrice on sale); paint pages do not (the price depends on the size chosen in the Knockout add-to-cart wizard), so a paint page returns PRICE_MISSING with its title and description. The add-to-cart button is rendered by Knockout, so availability is not configured. The description is the paragraphs of the Description section (#description, outside the main column, hence root is the page wrapper); the image is the gallery placeholder (resized by Magento). Roll width, roll length, repeat and ground/print colours are written as prose in that description, which the specs reader cannot pair, so fetch.engine is default (APP_DEFAULT_ENGINE, ai-crawler-avalai on this instance): the LLM returns them as specs (5 on the sample), each checked against the page. The selectors are the http fallback and the saved fixture. Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, price $270.00, image and description, no specs; browser: the same, slower; duckduckgo, mojeek, yandex: SEARCH_PROVIDER_BLOCKED; yahoo: SEARCH_PROVIDER_ERROR; brave: not tried, no key; ai-crawler-avalai: SUCCESS with the same fields, availability and 5 specs at 3,377+853 tokens; ai-crawler-cloudflare: not configured. ai-crawler-avalai is selected because it returns more data (specs); drop fetch to use http and save the tokens if specs are not needed. Needs APP_AI_CRAWLER_ENABLED with an AvalAI key on the instance. Checked against saved (curl) Five Over Stripe wallpaper and Reduced Green Estate Emulsion paint pages on 2026-11-19.
